description:
We often hear that it takes a village to raise a child. But what if we have overlooked something essential? Before we can raise thriving, resilient children, we must first raise and support - the parents. In this insightful and timely talk, Anita shifts the inclusion conversation to a group frequently left at the margins: parents. “It Takes a Village to Raise a Parent” challenges the assumption that parenting is a private matter. Anita makes the case that parents are foundational to everything - to workplaces, to schools, to communities and to the future of society itself.  Anita is the UK’s leading expert in guiding expectant parents through one of life’s most significant and universal transitions: entering parenthood. Trusted by clients worldwide, including royalty and celebrities like Tom Ford and Adele, she is regarded as a best-kept secret among new parents globally.
